youtube_title: Brakes Failed on the Highway: Yank the Handbrake or Gear Down? Brave vs Normal #10 #Shorts
youtube_description:
BRAVE vs NORMAL - WHO'S RIGHT? #10. On the highway the brake pedal goes to the floor. Brave yanks the handbrake in one jerk. Normal turns on hazard lights, pumps the brake, shifts down one gear at a time and pulls the handbrake slowly. Who's right?
Answer: Normal. Driving safety advice (RACV, Michelin) says: hazard lights and horn, pump the brake pedal, shift down gradually, use the handbrake gently - yanking it at speed can lock the rear wheels and make the car skid or spin - then steer to a safe spot and stop.
Source: RACV and Michelin brake-failure advice.
